action: a doll holding a transparent orb, moves it in front of its chesta and holds it with both hands; and turns its head to the right.
caption: a creepy, yet whimsical, stitched doll with large button eyes and a wide, toothy grin, wearing a red dress, holding a transparent orb in one hand and carrying a small cloth bag. The doll has pigtails made of yarn and stands in a dimly lit, vintage-styled setting.
